items.text: Test scenario where a user with an existing booking tries to instant-join the video session without proper authorization token.
items.expected: The system should deny access and return an authorization error, ensuring unauthorized instant-join attempts are blocked to protect session integrity.

items.text: Test scenario where a user with a valid booking and correct video authorization token attempts to join the video session.
items.expected: The system should grant video session access, allowing seamless joining, confirming proper token validation and participant legitimacy.

items.text: Test scenario where a user has a confirmed booking but attempts to join the video room without presenting any room token.
items.expected: The system should prevent joining the video room and prompt for a valid token, enforcing security by requiring token presence alongside booking.
